classification.difficultyReason: Build up across several days and combine hours, minutes and seconds.

content.prompt: A yacht race started on Monday at 13:49:30 and finished when the last yacht arrived at its destination on Friday of the same week at 07:15:29. How long was the race in hours, minutes and seconds?

answer.worked:
Build up from the start time to the finish time.

Monday 13:49:30 to Monday 13:50:00: 30 seconds.

Monday 13:50:00 to Monday 14:00:00: 10 minutes.

Monday 14:00:00 to Tuesday 00:00:00: 10 hours.

Tuesday 00:00:00 to Friday 00:00:00: $3\times24=72$ hours.

Friday 00:00:00 to Friday 07:15:29: 7 hours, 15 minutes and 29 seconds.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total hours}&=10+72+7=89\\\text{Total minutes}&=10+15=25\\\text{Total seconds}&=30+29=59\end{align*}$$
The race lasted 89 hours, 25 minutes and 59 seconds.
